rspec_tour.description:
xl170 Narwhal WAN topology: single shared LAN, single consolidated client.
N validators and 1 client on one broadcast domain. Validator interfaces are shaped (25ms per interface -> 100ms RTT between validators). The single client interface is unshaped on the LAN (baseline 50ms RTT to any validator). SO_MARK-based tc rules on the client add extra one-way delay for remote flows so that region i -> validator j (i!=j) gets 100ms RTT.
The benchmark_client sets SO_MARK = region_id * N + v_idx + 1 on each TCP socket. The tc fw filters match these marks and route remote flows through netem delay qdiscs.
Latency breakdown: node-i <-> node-j RTT: 25ms(i) + 25ms(i) + 25ms(j) + 25ms(j) = 100ms client region-i -> own node-i RTT: 0(tc) + 25(delay) + 25(delay) + 0 = 50ms client region-i -> remote node-j RTT: 50(tc) + 25(delay) + 25(delay) + 0 = 100ms
